insights.insight: [tension] PROVISIONAL (no client data yet). When someone in Almaty has lived for months with a gap or a failing bridge, they want to chew and smile without thinking about it, but they fear the surgery itself («это больно?», «сверлят кость»), so they postpone it or stay with a removable denture. We can show what actually happens, step by step, from the patient's side: the tray being laid out, sealed instruments, the doctor's close voice explaining each step. We never promise painlessness: «без боли» is rejected by the medical-ad rules (E02) and the anaesthesia protocol is a NEEDS FACT. This moves booked implant consultations because surgical anxiety is the hypothesised consideration bottleneck.
insights.tension: Wants a normal tooth back vs fears the operation (pain, «кость», the unknown chair experience)
insights.who_feels_it: Adults who have lost a tooth or have a failing bridge or denture and have postponed implants for months because of fear of the procedure
insights.content_reality: «кабинет»: doctor's gloved hands laying out the tray, close-mic voice (≤30 cm, recorded separately in «тихий угол») narrating what happens at each step. No faces, no mouths, no drill close-ups. No claim about pain or anaesthesia until the doctor confirms the protocol, so this is recognition/explanation content only. «Нам пишут: „Это больно?“» is blocked until the export shows ≥2 real messages.

insights.insight: [hidden_knowledge] PROVISIONAL. Before booking, a person considering implants wants to know what they are walking into, but they fear the first consultation is a sales trap («насчитают на миллион») and do not know what happens there, so they ask the price in chat and disappear when they hear «только на консультации». We can show the first visit as a sequence: what the doctor checks, what you leave with, and that you decide later. All steps are NEEDS FACT from the owner. Honest-signal content where the doctor says when they would advise waiting or another option (owner/doctor-confirmed only) separates us from the promo-led category (E23). This sits directly on the measured action, booking a consultation, so it has the highest leverage.
insights.tension: Wants a clear answer before committing vs fears being pressured into an expensive plan at the first visit
insights.who_feels_it: People who have asked a clinic for an implant price at least once and did not book because the next step felt like a commitment
insights.content_reality: «кабинет»: the empty consultation desk, the jaw model in the doctor's hands, close-voice walkthrough of the visit (voice recorded in «тихий угол»). No imaging of real patients. The sequence, its duration and whether the consultation is free are NEEDS FACT, so until confirmed this is recognition content only («вот что обычно спрашивают на первом приёме»).

insights.insight: [friction] PROVISIONAL. When someone starts comparing implant clinics, they want a number to compare, but a private clinic cannot give one before an examination (and no prices are in the ledger: E01, E33), so price-first chats stall (hypothesis E10) and the person picks whoever posted an «от … ₸» promo. We can show what the price depends on: number of teeth, bone, imaging, crown type, framed as the doctor's opinion with no figures. The CTA promises only what staff can keep (e.g. explaining what the consultation includes), plus an agent-drafted WhatsApp reply that always gives a next step. This moves coded chats → bookings because it converts the dead-end price question into a booking question.
insights.tension: Wants a comparable price now vs a quote that honestly depends on an exam they haven't had
insights.who_feels_it: People messaging several Almaty clinics in the same week asking «сколько стоит имплант»
insights.content_reality: «тихий угол»: administrator's hands typing the reply on a phone (anonymised chat card in screen mode), plus the doctor's hands on the jaw model in «кабинет» pointing to each factor. No prices, no comparisons with other clinics. Fixing the WhatsApp reply script is a non-content fix flagged with this insight.

insights.insight: [proof] PROVISIONAL. When a patient sits in a surgical chair, they want to trust that everything entering their mouth is clean, but sterilisation happens behind a closed door («инструменты одноразовые?»), so they judge the clinic by the interior instead. We can film the real sterilisation ritual: pouches sealed, the steriliser cycle, a sealed pouch torn open on the tray. The camera verifies whatever is filmed. Before/after content is rejected here because it needs written consent (E02), and this is the honest proof that replaces it. It builds the trust that precedes booking an operation.
insights.tension: Wants certainty of safety vs cannot see what happens behind the door
insights.who_feels_it: People choosing a clinic for a surgical procedure who worry about hygiene and have no way to check it
insights.content_reality: «стерилизационная»: hands sealing pouches, steriliser door and beep, and in «кабинет» the crackle of a sealed pouch being opened at 20–30 cm. Verified only once filmed. Do not claim «одноразовое» or a sterilisation standard until the owner confirms (NEEDS FACT).

insights.insight: [myth] PROVISIONAL. When someone has been told «кости нет» or believes «мост проще» or «импланты — для пожилых», they want the simplest fix, but the belief closes the implant option before a doctor has looked, so they settle for a bridge or denture by default. A doctor can explain on a jaw model what the belief gets wrong and what it depends on, framed as the doctor's opinion («врач считает»), with no outcome promise and only after the responsible doctor signs off the wording. This moves consultations because a belief is the hidden reason some people never ask.
insights.tension: Wants the easy option vs a belief that rules out the better-fitting one without an exam
insights.who_feels_it: People who were once told implants are impossible or unnecessary for them, and older patients assuming it is not for their age
insights.content_reality: «кабинет»: doctor's hands on the jaw model showing bone, bridge and implant positions, close voice. An AI explainer is allowed only for the invisible (bone inside the jaw) and must be labelled. There is no clinical proof on camera, so this is explanation and belief-check only, never «вам подойдёт».

insights.insight: [moment] PROVISIONAL. Right after a tooth is pulled, when a denture starts slipping, or before a family той or photos, the gap suddenly matters and the person wants to act, but does not know how long the path is («сколько ходить без зуба?»), so the urge fades and they wait for the next trigger. We can meet them at that moment with what to do in the first weeks after losing a tooth and what the steps are (sequence and timing are NEEDS FACT). We never promise «успеете к тою». This moves bookings because a moment is when consideration turns into a message.
insights.tension: Motivated right now vs the process looks long and uncertain, so the motivation decays
insights.who_feels_it: People who just had a tooth removed, whose denture or bridge just failed, or who have a family celebration ahead
insights.content_reality: «кабинет» / «тихий угол»: hands drawing a simple timeline on paper next to the jaw model, close voice. No dates or durations until the doctor confirms the typical sequence. Seasonal hooks (той season, New Year photos) are planned 10–14 days ahead.

insights.insight: [identity] WILDCARD, PROVISIONAL. When an adult child sees a parent struggling to chew with a removable denture, they want the parent to eat comfortably at the family table, but the parent says «мне уже не надо» and fears the operation, so nothing happens. The decision-maker and the patient are different people. We can speak to the child: what to ask the parent, and what a first consultation is (we can't see this yet, so it is recognition and explanation only). It creates a natural share line («скинь маме») and a second route into bookings.
insights.tension: Child wants the parent's comfort vs the parent's refusal and fear
insights.who_feels_it: Adult children in Almaty arranging and often paying for an older parent's dental treatment
insights.content_reality: «тихий угол»: hands only. A cup of tea and a plate of food on a family table plus the jaw model, close voice. No real patients or relatives on camera. Whether relatives make first contact is unverified, so this is recognition content only until the export shows who writes first.

insights.insight: [content_reality] WILDCARD, PROVISIONAL. Outsiders picture an implant as a big «винт в челюсти» from 3D animations (category convention E24), but almost nobody has held the real object. Showing the actual implant or a demo sample in gloved hands, next to an everyday object, is a curiosity gap that also quietly shrinks the fear («снаружи этого никто не видел»). Per E30, the object must answer a patient question («что вообще ставят?»), not be a bare product demo. It feeds reach and wildcard ideas; no brand or dimensions are named until confirmed.
insights.tension: Outsider curiosity: «что это вообще такое и какого оно размера?» vs the scary mental image
insights.who_feels_it: Anyone who has heard «имплант» but never seen one, including people quietly afraid of it
insights.content_reality: «кабинет»: a demo implant in gloved hands next to a familiar object, macro shot at 20–30 cm. Requires the owner to confirm a demo sample exists (NEEDS FACT). No brand label visible, no size numbers on screen.

insights.insight: [content_reality] WILDCARD, PROVISIONAL. Clinic sounds feed the fear: people hear a whine through the wall and imagine the worst. The quiet sounds of preparation are unseen rituals: a pouch tearing open, instruments placed on a tray, the steriliser beep. A «угадайте звук» or close-sound piece can decode what each sound is, which turns the clinic's soundscape from threat into routine. Using the drill sound as a pleasurable sensory loop is rejected because it is the fear trigger (E27). Honest risk: it may still remind viewers of the chair, so its prior stays low.
insights.tension: Outsider curiosity about what the sounds are vs those sounds being the source of dread
insights.who_feels_it: People who feel anxious at the mere sound of a dental clinic
insights.content_reality: «стерилизационная» and «кабинет»: one continuous close-sound take (pouch, tray, steriliser) at 20–30 cm, no faces, no patients. Verified only after the reality scan confirms audio quality.

insights.insight: [price_value] PROVISIONAL. When someone sees «имплант от …» promos (E23) and then hears a higher quote, they want to believe the difference is real, but they cannot see what the price contains, so they assume overcharging or choose the cheapest ad. The «above average» positioning (E06) is only a self-description. We could show where the money goes (imaging, planning, sterile single-use kit, components) only after the owner confirms each element, and never as a price slide (E31). This defends booking conversion against promo competition without naming any clinic.
insights.tension: Wants value for a large spend vs suspects the higher price is just markup
insights.who_feels_it: People who have received a cheaper implant quote or seen promo ads and are deciding whether a pricier clinic is worth it
insights.content_reality: «стерилизационная» / «кабинет»: hands showing each component or step of the plan in order, close voice. Every element is NEEDS FACT from the owner. Without confirmation it stays unusable for claims and can only become a question prompt («что входит в цену имплантации — спросите у врача»).

insights.insight: [tension] PROVISIONAL (no client data yet). When someone in Almaty has lived for months with a gap or a failing bridge, they want to chew and smile without thinking about it, but they fear the surgery itself («это больно?», «сверлят кость»), so they postpone it or stay with a removable denture. We can show what actually happens, step by step, from the patient's side: the tray being laid out, sealed instruments, the doctor's close voice explaining each step. We never promise painlessness: «без боли» is rejected by the medical-ad rules (E02) and the anaesthesia protocol is a NEEDS FACT. This moves booked implant consultations because surgical anxiety is the hypothesised consideration bottleneck.
insights.tension: Wants a normal tooth back vs fears the operation (pain, «кость», the unknown chair experience)
insights.who_feels_it: Adults who have lost a tooth or have a failing bridge or denture and have postponed implants for months because of fear of the procedure
insights.content_reality: «кабинет»: doctor's gloved hands laying out the tray, close-mic voice (≤30 cm, recorded separately in «тихий угол») narrating what happens at each step. No faces, no mouths, no drill close-ups. No claim about pain or anaesthesia until the doctor confirms the protocol, so this is recognition/explanation content only. «Нам пишут: „Это больно?“» is blocked until the export shows ≥2 real messages.

insights.insight: [hidden_knowledge] PROVISIONAL. Before booking, a person considering implants wants to know what they are walking into, but they fear the first consultation is a sales trap («насчитают на миллион») and do not know what happens there, so they ask the price in chat and disappear when they hear «только на консультации». We can show the first visit as a sequence: what the doctor checks, what you leave with, and that you decide later. All steps are NEEDS FACT from the owner. Honest-signal content where the doctor says when they would advise waiting or another option (owner/doctor-confirmed only) separates us from the promo-led category (E23). This sits directly on the measured action, booking a consultation, so it has the highest leverage.
insights.tension: Wants a clear answer before committing vs fears being pressured into an expensive plan at the first visit
insights.who_feels_it: People who have asked a clinic for an implant price at least once and did not book because the next step felt like a commitment
insights.content_reality: «кабинет»: the empty consultation desk, the jaw model in the doctor's hands, close-voice walkthrough of the visit (voice recorded in «тихий угол»). No imaging of real patients. The sequence, its duration and whether the consultation is free are NEEDS FACT, so until confirmed this is recognition content only («вот что обычно спрашивают на первом приёме»).

insights.insight: [friction] PROVISIONAL. When someone starts comparing implant clinics, they want a number to compare, but a private clinic cannot give one before an examination (and no prices are in the ledger: E01, E33), so price-first chats stall (hypothesis E10) and the person picks whoever posted an «от … ₸» promo. We can show what the price depends on: number of teeth, bone, imaging, crown type, framed as the doctor's opinion with no figures. The CTA promises only what staff can keep (e.g. explaining what the consultation includes), plus an agent-drafted WhatsApp reply that always gives a next step. This moves coded chats → bookings because it converts the dead-end price question into a booking question.
insights.tension: Wants a comparable price now vs a quote that honestly depends on an exam they haven't had
insights.who_feels_it: People messaging several Almaty clinics in the same week asking «сколько стоит имплант»
insights.content_reality: «тихий угол»: administrator's hands typing the reply on a phone (anonymised chat card in screen mode), plus the doctor's hands on the jaw model in «кабинет» pointing to each factor. No prices, no comparisons with other clinics. Fixing the WhatsApp reply script is a non-content fix flagged with this insight.

insights.insight: [proof] PROVISIONAL. When a patient sits in a surgical chair, they want to trust that everything entering their mouth is clean, but sterilisation happens behind a closed door («инструменты одноразовые?»), so they judge the clinic by the interior instead. We can film the real sterilisation ritual: pouches sealed, the steriliser cycle, a sealed pouch torn open on the tray. The camera verifies whatever is filmed. Before/after content is rejected here because it needs written consent (E02), and this is the honest proof that replaces it. It builds the trust that precedes booking an operation.
insights.tension: Wants certainty of safety vs cannot see what happens behind the door
insights.who_feels_it: People choosing a clinic for a surgical procedure who worry about hygiene and have no way to check it
insights.content_reality: «стерилизационная»: hands sealing pouches, steriliser door and beep, and in «кабинет» the crackle of a sealed pouch being opened at 20–30 cm. Verified only once filmed. Do not claim «одноразовое» or a sterilisation standard until the owner confirms (NEEDS FACT).

insights.insight: [myth] PROVISIONAL. When someone has been told «кости нет» or believes «мост проще» or «импланты — для пожилых», they want the simplest fix, but the belief closes the implant option before a doctor has looked, so they settle for a bridge or denture by default. A doctor can explain on a jaw model what the belief gets wrong and what it depends on, framed as the doctor's opinion («врач считает»), with no outcome promise and only after the responsible doctor signs off the wording. This moves consultations because a belief is the hidden reason some people never ask.
insights.tension: Wants the easy option vs a belief that rules out the better-fitting one without an exam
insights.who_feels_it: People who were once told implants are impossible or unnecessary for them, and older patients assuming it is not for their age
insights.content_reality: «кабинет»: doctor's hands on the jaw model showing bone, bridge and implant positions, close voice. An AI explainer is allowed only for the invisible (bone inside the jaw) and must be labelled. There is no clinical proof on camera, so this is explanation and belief-check only, never «вам подойдёт».

insights.insight: [moment] PROVISIONAL. Right after a tooth is pulled, when a denture starts slipping, or before a family той or photos, the gap suddenly matters and the person wants to act, but does not know how long the path is («сколько ходить без зуба?»), so the urge fades and they wait for the next trigger. We can meet them at that moment with what to do in the first weeks after losing a tooth and what the steps are (sequence and timing are NEEDS FACT). We never promise «успеете к тою». This moves bookings because a moment is when consideration turns into a message.
insights.tension: Motivated right now vs the process looks long and uncertain, so the motivation decays
insights.who_feels_it: People who just had a tooth removed, whose denture or bridge just failed, or who have a family celebration ahead
insights.content_reality: «кабинет» / «тихий угол»: hands drawing a simple timeline on paper next to the jaw model, close voice. No dates or durations until the doctor confirms the typical sequence. Seasonal hooks (той season, New Year photos) are planned 10–14 days ahead.

insights.insight: [identity] WILDCARD, PROVISIONAL. When an adult child sees a parent struggling to chew with a removable denture, they want the parent to eat comfortably at the family table, but the parent says «мне уже не надо» and fears the operation, so nothing happens. The decision-maker and the patient are different people. We can speak to the child: what to ask the parent, and what a first consultation is (we can't see this yet, so it is recognition and explanation only). It creates a natural share line («скинь маме») and a second route into bookings.
insights.tension: Child wants the parent's comfort vs the parent's refusal and fear
insights.who_feels_it: Adult children in Almaty arranging and often paying for an older parent's dental treatment
insights.content_reality: «тихий угол»: hands only. A cup of tea and a plate of food on a family table plus the jaw model, close voice. No real patients or relatives on camera. Whether relatives make first contact is unverified, so this is recognition content only until the export shows who writes first.

insights.insight: [content_reality] WILDCARD, PROVISIONAL. Outsiders picture an implant as a big «винт в челюсти» from 3D animations (category convention E24), but almost nobody has held the real object. Showing the actual implant or a demo sample in gloved hands, next to an everyday object, is a curiosity gap that also quietly shrinks the fear («снаружи этого никто не видел»). Per E30, the object must answer a patient question («что вообще ставят?»), not be a bare product demo. It feeds reach and wildcard ideas; no brand or dimensions are named until confirmed.
insights.tension: Outsider curiosity: «что это вообще такое и какого оно размера?» vs the scary mental image
insights.who_feels_it: Anyone who has heard «имплант» but never seen one, including people quietly afraid of it
insights.content_reality: «кабинет»: a demo implant in gloved hands next to a familiar object, macro shot at 20–30 cm. Requires the owner to confirm a demo sample exists (NEEDS FACT). No brand label visible, no size numbers on screen.

insights.insight: [content_reality] WILDCARD, PROVISIONAL. Clinic sounds feed the fear: people hear a whine through the wall and imagine the worst. The quiet sounds of preparation are unseen rituals: a pouch tearing open, instruments placed on a tray, the steriliser beep. A «угадайте звук» or close-sound piece can decode what each sound is, which turns the clinic's soundscape from threat into routine. Using the drill sound as a pleasurable sensory loop is rejected because it is the fear trigger (E27). Honest risk: it may still remind viewers of the chair, so its prior stays low.
insights.tension: Outsider curiosity about what the sounds are vs those sounds being the source of dread
insights.who_feels_it: People who feel anxious at the mere sound of a dental clinic
insights.content_reality: «стерилизационная» and «кабинет»: one continuous close-sound take (pouch, tray, steriliser) at 20–30 cm, no faces, no patients. Verified only after the reality scan confirms audio quality.

insights.insight: [price_value] PROVISIONAL. When someone sees «имплант от …» promos (E23) and then hears a higher quote, they want to believe the difference is real, but they cannot see what the price contains, so they assume overcharging or choose the cheapest ad. The «above average» positioning (E06) is only a self-description. We could show where the money goes (imaging, planning, sterile single-use kit, components) only after the owner confirms each element, and never as a price slide (E31). This defends booking conversion against promo competition without naming any clinic.
insights.tension: Wants value for a large spend vs suspects the higher price is just markup
insights.who_feels_it: People who have received a cheaper implant quote or seen promo ads and are deciding whether a pricier clinic is worth it
insights.content_reality: «стерилизационная» / «кабинет»: hands showing each component or step of the plan in order, close voice. Every element is NEEDS FACT from the owner. Without confirmation it stays unusable for claims and can only become a question prompt («что входит в цену имплантации — спросите у врача»).

output.name: Behind the door: implant consultations, Almaty (sprint 2026-10-12 → 2026-11-15)
output.big_idea: People put off implants because the parts they fear happen behind a closed door: the instruments, the plan, the first visit, what a surgeon really says. This clinic opens that door on camera, one hidden step at a time, and invites people to come and ask before they decide. It can give 20+ episodes, because every reprocessing step, consultation step and doctor's answer is its own episode. It can be proven on camera, because we show only what the camera actually films. And it points to the measured action: book a consultation by code.

output.why_this_wins:
This is not a forecast. Every insight is PROVISIONAL and rated strength 2, because the client is hypothetical and the ledger is empty. This plan is built to learn quickly without saying anything untrue.

(1) The message makes no claim about the business. It invites the viewer to look, so it needs no fact id. It is safe because facts_usable is empty, and medical-ad rules (E02) rule out outcome claims. Peers lead with promos and 3D animations (E23, E24), so 'show the door' gives the clinic a position they do not hold.

(2) The hero «Что за дверью» (ID02, ID03) rests on I04 (E18, E26, E27, E21). It is the only proof in this plan that the camera checks for itself, so it replaces before/after content, which needs written consent (E02).

(3) The conversion series «Вопрос врачу» (ID04, ID05, ID21) aims at the consideration bottleneck we suspect. It answers the fear of surgery (I01: E13, E20) and the fear that a consultation is a sales trap (I02: E17, E23). The honest-signal content in ID05 is something the promo-led category does not do.

(4) Two wildcards test reach and the idea that someone other than the patient decides: ID14, where an adult child is the decision-maker (I07: E36), and ID11, which shows the real size of an implant (I08: E24, E30).

(5) Learning plan: 4 series across 8 drivers and 8 formats. Each post is read at 48 h and 7 days against the pooled dental median until the account has 10 posts of its own. Allocation runs on relative views plus shares and saves until the account has 20 coded chats, then switches to coded chats per 1k views.

The week-0 chat export decides whether the bottleneck is really consideration or is conversion (slow replies, or a price question left with no next step). If it is conversion, the WhatsApp layer is fixed before any more content is made.

A small fixed tag «Что за дверью» sits upper-left and the hook is upper-middle. Fixed structure: hidden step → next step → payoff 'all of this happens before you sit in the chair' → soft CTA. decision_rules: DR0 (judgment, regulated): an idea whose NEEDS FACT items (doctor/owner) are not confirmed by Wed 12:00 is not published. A confirmed reserve takes its slot (order: ID11 → ID21 → ID20). Nothing goes out without the owner's batch approval and the responsible doctor's sign-off.
DR1 Read: every post at 48 h and at 7 days, against that platform's median of the last 15 posts (pooled dental median until 10 own posts).

DR2 Breakout: ≥3× platform median at 48 h ([ASSUMPTION] Reels median ~1,000 → ≥3,000 views; replaced by the real median after the week-0 fetch), or shares+saves per 1k ≥2× median. Within 7 days: 2 follow-ups (part 2 or the same insight in a new format, plus a reply to the top comment). Pin it if conversion-relevant, put it on WhatsApp Status, mark it boost-eligible. At ≥10× it becomes a series, and the owner hears «вирусный» described as a tail event, not a plan.
DR3 Hook failure: 3-s hold <0.7× account median → re-cut with a different first frame and hook text (no gloved-hand top-down if the original had one), repost ≥7 days later, once only.
DR4 Body failure: hold OK but completion <0.7× median → shorten and move the payoff earlier in the next episode; no repost as is.

DR5 Conversion-layer miss: views on plan but coded chats <30% of the 2026-11-01 plan by week 3 → before more content, check the spoken and on-screen code, the caption and pinned comment, the wa.me bio link, phone logging, and reply time.

DR6 Sales-handling miss: coded chats on plan, bookings low → report where chats die (after the price? after «подумаю»?) and draft reply scripts. Price, the consultation fee and any offer are the owner's call.
DR7 Attention-only arm: ≥10 posts, ≥10,000 views, 0 coded chats while other arms convert → cap at 1 post/week (likely candidates: ID11, ID14).
DR8 Retire: P(arm beats client median) <0.10 after ≥8 posts → exploration floor for this client; the data stays in the pool.

DR9 Boost: only DR2 posts with ≥1 coded chat or a conversion role. Needs owner budget + owner-confirmed RK medical-ad compliance. Cap per coded chat = avg implant plan × gross margin × consultation→plan rate × chat→consultation rate × 0.3 (owner numbers). Stop after spending 5× the cap with <3 coded chats, or when cost per coded chat rises 3 days in a row. Never with an unconfirmed offer.

DR10 Capacity: new implant-consultation bookings ≥80% of the free surgeon capacity from Q1 (default: +20% over the week-0 count) → pause conversion pieces («Вопрос врачу» CTAs) and shift to «Что за дверью» and reach.
DR11 Honesty kill-switch: a comment credibly disputes a fact or alleges harm or a complaint → pause that series, take the conversation private, verify with the doctor, tell the owner the same day.

DR11b Medical comments (judgment): no diagnosis, prognosis or price in public replies. The reply draft is «это решает врач после осмотра — напишите {CODE}, подскажем, как записаться», and the doctor approves before posting.

DR12 Pivot: by week 4–6, no arm with P >0.6 and the primary metric <25% of target → rerun step 3 with fresh chats and voice notes, diagnose the funnel (reply time, price position, reviews, surgeon availability), and send the owner an honest report with options.
DR13 Claims: 'winner' only with P(best) ≥0.9, n ≥10 per contender and an interval; otherwise «лидирует, рано судить».
DR14 Staff: card completion <80% for 2 weeks → fewer locations, face-free shots, shorter takes, more zero-minute library cuts.
DR15 Owner/doctor: rejections >30% → read the reasons and update the constraints; a fact rejection means fixing the ledger.
DR16 Never delete flops, except for truth, consent, medical-ad or legal problems.

Имена и номера удаляем сразу, наружу ничего не попадает. По умолчанию (если не пришлёте до 16.10): считаем узкое место «страх перед операцией» и проверяем по комментариям.
owner_asks.why: Confirms or overturns the consideration bottleneck. Gives the close rate, reply time, real question clusters (needed for the «Нам пишут» framing) and the relatives hypothesis.

owner_asks.ask: Перешлите врачу-имплантологу 6 вопросов «да/нет» (займёт у него ~5 минут): 1) порядок обработки инструмента: мойка → пакет → стерилизатор? 2) пакет вскрывают при пациенте? 3) план объясняют на модели челюсти? 4) бывает, что вы советуете не ставить имплант — в каких случаях (2–3 слова)? 5) консультация ни к чему не обязывает? 6) есть демонстрационный имплант, который можно снять без логотипа? Плюс: врач согласен записать голос (без лица) и утвердить ответ про ощущения/анестезию? По умолчанию: ролики с неподтверждёнными пунктами не выходят.
owner_asks.why: Clears the NEEDS FACT gates for ID02, ID03, ID04, ID05 and ID11. Without these answers most of week 1 cannot be published.

owner_asks.ask: Утвердите один раз готовые ответы для WhatsApp (пришлём 3 шаблона) и попросите администратора: метки «Видео» и «Имплант-консультация», а звонящих спрашивать «по какому видео?» и отмечать в листе. 1 — да, 2 — поправлю. По умолчанию: 1, с 19.10.
owner_asks.why: Conversion layer and attribution: phone is a major channel, and an unanswered price question is the likely leak.

owner_asks.ask: Правила медрекламы РК: подтвердите, что можно 1) рассказы пациентов голосом с письменным согласием, 2) платное продвижение роликов. Варианты: да / нет / уточню у юриста. По умолчанию: нет для обоих, ID20 и продвижение не запускаем.
owner_asks.why: ID20 and any boost are blocked without this. We supply the text but give no legal advice.

owner_asks.ask: Завести TikTok и YouTube на клинику? 1 — да, сами, 2 — да, дайте доступ нам, 3 — только Instagram. По умолчанию: 3.
owner_asks.why: Cross-posting triples the test bed at no staff cost. Without it, arms learn more slowly.

owner_asks.ask: Еженедельно (≤5 минут, среда): одобрить пакет из 5 роликов вместе с визой врача — «да» / «убрать №…». По умолчанию: без ответа ничего не публикуем.
owner_asks.why: L8 plus the regulated category: nothing goes out without the owner's and the responsible doctor's approval.

risks: HYPOTHETICAL CLIENT: every business detail (6 chairs, 2 surgeons, ~3k followers, 'prices above average') is an assumption; the ledger is empty, so no number, price, brand, duration or experience claim appears in any audience string.

Owner onboarding minutes: the campaign asks total ~12 min plus the 3 intake questions (~3 min) = ~15 min; the weekly approval (5 min) is a separate weekly budget. If the owner is slower, the export and the doctor sheet come first.
NEEDS FACT: clinic reprocessing steps and their order (doctor) — blocks ID02 step captions.
NEEDS FACT: sterile pouch opened in front of the patient; plan explained on a jaw model at consultation (doctor) — blocks ID03.
NEEDS FACT: anaesthesia/sensation answer in the doctor's own signed-off words; the doctor consents to voice recording (doctor) — blocks ID04, whose hook has no payoff without it.
NEEDS FACT: the surgeon's real criteria for advising against an implant; the consultation is non-binding (doctor + owner) — blocks ID05.
NEEDS FACT: a demo implant sample exists and can be filmed without a brand (owner) — blocks ID11.
NEEDS FACT: written patient consent for voice use, plus owner-confirmed RK legality of patient experience stories (owner) — blocks ID20.
NEEDS FACT: what the consultation includes, its duration and whether it is free (owner) — needed before any CTA states more than «расскажем, как проходит консультация».
NEEDS FACT: free implant-consultation capacity per week (Q1) — DR10 runs on the +20% default until answered.
REGULATED: no «без боли», «навсегда», «приживается», «за 1 день», no before/after, no AI depiction of results, no diagnosis in comments; the doctor signs off every batch.

Creative repetition: ID02, ID04 and ID05 all open on gloved hands seen top-down. Mitigated by publishing order and edit-time hook variants that change the first frame, but the series could still feel samey by week 3.
Truth/framing: ID04 must not use «Нам пишут» until the export shows ≥2 matching messages; ID14's chat is staged and labelled «постановка», and it must not mock older people.
METHOD/code conflict noted: the D3 guess pattern «Угадайте…» trips the H2 bait lexicon; ID11 uses a plain question plus a true reveal instead.
Attribution: implant decisions take weeks, so in-sprint surgeries undercount; codes undercount (the phone especially); the coded count is a floor.
Organic reach on a ~3k account is highly variable; the REALISM verdict waits until 2026-11-01 and the warm base (WhatsApp Status) is the fallback lever.
Non-marketing leaks (slow replies, price position, recent bad reviews, surgeon availability) may dominate; DR5/DR6 check them before more content.
NEXT BATCH: a moment idea for I06 (after an extraction / той season, planned 10–14 days ahead) — none on the slate.

NEXT BATCH: a friction idea for I03 (the «сколько стоит имплант» chat answered with what the price depends on, no figures) and a myth_check for I05 («кости нет», «мост проще»), signed off by the doctor.
NEXT BATCH: 2+ ideas whose first frame is not gloved hands top-down (e.g. a voice-first question card, a paper timeline, a screen-mode chat card) to protect first-frame diversity.
NEXT BATCH: why_it_costs / budget_ladder for I10 only after dated prices and the owner's confirmation of each cost element (Q3 = 1).

output.persona: Владелец стоматологии в Алматы (гипотетическая клиника: 6 кресел, 2 хирурга-имплантолога, цены выше среднего). Мне нужны пациенты на импланты, а не охваты. Я плачу за время хирургов и администратора и отвечаю перед регулятором за каждое слово в медрекламе.
output.best_idea: ID05 «Когда хирург сам отговаривает от импланта». Это единственный ролик, который бьёт прямо в главный страх дорогой клиники: «меня разведут на деньги». Он честный, лицо снимать не нужно, а хирург сам решает, о каких случаях говорить. Ещё полезны шаблоны ответов в WhatsApp: ответ на «сколько стоит» всегда заканчивается предложением записаться. Это может дать записи быстрее любого ролика.

refutations.target: Главный рычаг: органические ролики на аккаунте ~3k за 4 недели (раздел REALISM, weeks 1–4)
refutations.why_fails: Вы сами пишете, что выйдет от 2 до 43 закодированных консультаций. Разброс в 20 раз, то есть прогноза нет. А самый дешёвый и быстрый источник, наша собственная база, стоит в плане запасным вариантом в виде WhatsApp Status. Я имею в виду пациентов, которым удаляли зуб, кто был на консультации по имплантам и не начал лечение, и тех, у кого старые мосты и съёмные протезы. Таких у нас в МИС сотни. Это тёплые люди: им можно позвонить или написать лично на этой же неделе, и запись будет уже в октябре. Платную рекламу (Instagram, 2GIS) вы тоже откладываете до 3-й недели. В итоге 4 недели уходят на «обучение рук», а мне нужны пациенты.
refutations.fix: Сделать работу с базой основным рычагом с недели 0. Админ выгружает пациентов с удалениями и неначатыми планами имплантации за 24 месяца и пишет им персонально (текст согласует врач, без обещаний и без «акций»), со своим кодом. Ролики остаются вторым слоем доверия. Вопрос о бюджете на 2GIS и рекламу задать на онбординге, а не на 3-й неделе.

refutations.target: Время хирургов: голос в ID03, ID04, ID05; виза на каждую партию; 6 вопросов да/нет; утверждение ответов на комментарии (DR11b)
refutations.why_fails: В бюджете есть «≤17 минут персонала» и «5 минут владельца», а минут хирурга нет совсем. При этом хирург должен записывать голос в 3 из 5 роликов первой недели (по 3 дубля), визировать каждую партию, утверждать каждый ответ в комментариях и формулировку про анестезию. Час хирурга — это самый дорогой час в клинике. Если он устанет от этого на второй неделе, встанут и ID04/ID05, и вся серия «Вопрос врачу».
refutations.fix: Отдельно посчитать минуты хирурга в неделю с потолком (например, ≤15 минут). Все голосовые записать за одну сессию на неделе 0, чтобы получился запас ответов. Визу делать раз в неделю пакетом, а ответы в комментариях — по заранее утверждённым шаблонам, без согласования каждого.

refutations.target: Главная серия «Что за дверью» (ID02, ID03): стерилизация как основное доказательство
refutations.why_fails: Во-первых, это не про импланты: так же можно продавать гигиену у любой клиники. Во-вторых, это риск. Любой кадр стерилизационной видят СЭС, конкуренты и коллеги-стоматологи. Нет индикатора на пакете, не тот режим, перчатки не по протоколу — и в комментариях нас разбирают публично. В-третьих, ID03 учит пациента: «проверьте, вскрывают ли пакет при вас». После этого каждая наша смена должна делать это без единого исключения, иначе первый же пациент снимет нас на телефон. А «на что смотреть при выборе клиники» читается как намёк на чужие клиники.
refutations.fix: Каждый кадр стерилизационной перед публикацией проверяет ответственный за санитарный режим, а не только хирург. ID03 переделать с «проверьте клинику» на «как у нас проходит консультация по имплантам». Хотя бы половину главной серии отдать именно имплантологии: КТ, планирование на модели, этапы лечения на макете. Это то, что отличает нас от «просто чистой клиники».

refutations.target: Язык рекламы в РК: весь текст на экране, хуки и CTA только на русском
refutations.why_fails: По законодательству РК реклама распространяется на казахском и русском языках. Вы пишете «предоставим KZ-текст, проверка носителем», но во всех роликах on_screen_ru только на русском. На мне как на владельце будет реклама только на русском языке, а это повод для проверки.
refutations.fix: Двуязычные субтитры или пары роликов RU/KZ для каждого публикуемого видео, вычитанные носителем языка до публикации. Добавить это в DR0 как условие публикации наравне с визой врача.

refutations.target: ID20 «Голос пациента»
refutations.why_fails: Закон РК о рекламе запрещает в рекламе медицинских услуг ссылаться на случаи излечения и благодарности пациентов. Рассказ «чего я боялся и как прошёл первый визит» — это по сути отзыв, даже без лица. Вы перекладываете юридическую оценку на меня («подтвердите»), но всё равно держите ролик в плане 1-й и 2-й недели и тратите на него время. Это потенциальный штраф, а не «тестовая гипотеза».
refutations.fix: Убрать ID20 из этого спринта. Вернуться к нему только после письменного заключения юриста. Страхи пациентов озвучивает врач в «Вопросе врачу», а не пациент.

refutations.target: Цена полностью вне контента (ограничение PRICES, нет roliков I03/I10 в слейте)
refutations.why_fails: Мы дороже среднего, и при выборе импланта главный вопрос — «сколько стоит». План ставит в гипотезы страх перед ценой, но ни один ролик в слейте на него не отвечает. Всё отложено в NEXT BATCH. Люди будут смотреть ролики про стерилизацию, а потом уходить в клинику, где цена написана в Instagram.
refutations.fix: В 1–2-ю неделю добавить один ролик «от чего зависит стоимость импланта» без цифр (КТ, сам имплант, костная пластика, коронка), согласованный с врачом. Мне задать вопрос не только «можно ли цены», но и «можно ли вилку „от“».

refutations.target: Цель и сроки: базовая линия неизвестна, цель фиксируется 01.11, окно атрибуции 30 дней при подсчёте за недели 3–4
refutations.why_fails: Сегодня я утверждаю план без цифр: цель — «1,5× от неизвестно чего». Записи из роликов 4-й недели по 30-дневному окну досчитаются уже после 15.11, то есть итог на 15.11 недосчитан. Неделя 0 — это всего одна неделя, и одна случайная неделя сдвигает весь множитель.
refutations.fix: Взять базовую линию из МИС: среднее число консультаций по имплантам в неделю за последние 8–12 недель (админ выгрузит за 10 минут) и зафиксировать цель в цифрах уже на онбординге. Отчёт по коду сделать 15.11 предварительным, а окончательным — 15.12.

refutations.target: ID11: хук «Настоящий имплант» при «Демонстрационный образец» в кадре
refutations.why_fails: Хук говорит «настоящий», а подпись — «демонстрационный». Внимательный зритель или коллега увидит в этом противоречие. Кроме того, связь с записями слабая, вы сами это признаёте.
refutations.fix: Хук: «Вот какого размера имплант. Ожидали больше?» Без слова «настоящий». Держать в резерве, а не в основном слоте.

refutations.target: ID14 POV «мама говорит „мне уже не надо“» с нарезкой яблока
refutations.why_fails: Постановочная переписка плюс нарезанное яблоко как намёк, что мама не может жевать, легко прочитать как насмешку над пожилыми или как давление на чувства детей. Для медрекламы, где мы обещаем «без давления», это тонкий лёд.
refutations.fix: Оставить ролик, но финал сделать без вины («просто сходите вместе узнать»), а текст утвердить мне лично. Если в комментариях начнут высмеивать старших, убрать по DR11.

refutations.target: Нагрузка на администратора: лист звонков, метки, коды, ответ ≤15 минут, Instagram DM, TikTok и YouTube
refutations.why_fails: Вы добавляете админу журнал звонков, две метки, вопрос «по какому видео» и SLA 15 минут, и не считаете это в минутах персонала. Пациенты по телефону коды не называют, так что данные будут грязными. Заводить ещё TikTok и YouTube для клиники с одним администратором — это дополнительный риск непрочитанных сообщений.
refutations.fix: Посчитать минуты админа явно. На звонке вместо кода спрашивать «откуда узнали» с 3 вариантами ответа. TikTok и YouTube отложить до момента, когда Instagram стабильно даёт обращения.

output.persona: veteran_creator: short-form creator and SMM for local businesses in Kazakhstan/CIS. I judge whether a plan can be shot on one weak phone in 20 minutes, whether people will share it, and whether it brings WhatsApp inquiries.
output.best_idea: ID05 «Когда хирург сам отговаривает от импланта». It is the only idea a promo-heavy Almaty dental feed doesn't already have. It shows the clinic won't upsell, which is the real fear behind "a consultation is a sales trap". It also brings warmer chats than reach pieces. Second choice is ID14 (the adult child deciding for mum). In KZ, children often pay for a parent's implants, so it spreads in family chats. Fix ID14's weak brand link: replace the generic CTA with «Напишите {CODE} — подскажем, как прийти на консультацию вместе с мамой», and show the clinic tag on the last frame.

refutations.target: Hero series «Что за дверью» (ID02 sterilisation cycle)
refutations.why_fails: Autoclave, pouch and washer reels are the most overused dental content in the CIS. Every clinic in Almaty and Astana has posted «куда уходит инструмент». They get saves from other dentists, not inquiries from implant patients. The video is about general hygiene, not implants, so a viewer with a missing tooth gets no reason to write. Calling a 2026 sterilisation reel 'a position competitors don't hold' is wrong; they hold it and it's worn out.
refutations.fix: Keep sterilisation as one episode only, not the hero. Point the hero at implant-specific hidden steps the camera can show without patients: the CT/plan screen on the doctor's monitor (blurred, no patient data), the surgical kit laid out for one implant case, the temporary tooth/crown model, the surgeon's hands drawing the plan on paper for 'one missing tooth vs three'. Episode-7 test: 'what the surgeon checks before saying yes to an implant'.

refutations.target: Price avoidance + low-intent CTAs (all ideas; I03 pushed to NEXT BATCH)
refutations.why_fails: In Almaty, the first message about implants is «сколько стоит имплант?» almost every time. The plan puts no price-related content in weeks 1–2, and its CTAs ask people to write in exchange for «расскажем, как проходит консультация». Nobody types a code for that. You'll get views and saves but almost no chats, and the low numbers will look like a 'consideration bottleneck' when they come from a weak call to action.
refutations.fix: Move the I03 idea («Из чего складывается цена импланта», no figures, doctor-approved: CT, the implant itself, the abutment, the crown, the number of visits) into week 1 as a «Вопрос врачу» episode. Change the CTA to a concrete deliverable: «Напишите {CODE} — врач скажет, какие этапы нужны именно в вашем случае, по фото или снимку». Only use it if the doctor agrees, but give people a reason to write.

refutations.target: Faceless doctor voice over gloved hands (ID02, ID03, ID04, ID05; 4 of 8 ideas)
refutations.why_fails: For a surgery decision, KZ/CIS patients trust a face and a name: «к какому врачу иду». An anonymous voice over cotton rolls feels like a stock ad, and repeated top-down gloved hands make the feed look like one video posted five times. ID04's tray-of-cotton-rolls B-roll has nothing to do with implant pain, so the picture and the words don't match.
refutations.fix: Make the surgeon's face (with consent) the default ask in Q2. Sell it to the owner as the main trust lever, not as an optional extra. Shoot him at a desk: phone on a stack of books at eye level, 50 cm away, with a 1,500 ₸ clip-on lav or the phone held at chest level for audio. If he refuses, use a single recurring visual identity (his hands + the name tag «Хирург-имплантолог Ерлан» on the desk) so the series has a recognisable person.

refutations.target: Language compliance: on_screen_ru / hook_ru only
refutations.why_fails: The RK advertising law requires ads distributed in Kazakhstan to be in Kazakh as well as Russian. Every on-screen text set in the plan is RU-only, and KZ is mentioned only as 'variants, native check before use'. A regulated medical advertiser posting RU-only promotional reels with CTAs is an easy complaint target. Also, medical ads in RK usually have to state licence details, and that is missing from the captions and bio.
refutations.fix: Burn in RU + KZ text for the hook and the CTA on every video (KZ as a second line, or in the caption plus the cover). Add the licence number to the bio and the caption template. Put both on the owner's compliance checklist as yes/no items, with no legal advice.

refutations.target: Doctor sign-off gate + Tuesday shoot before the Wednesday fact deadline (Week 1, DR0)
refutations.why_fails: A working implant surgeon will not answer 6 yes/no questions, record 3 voice takes per idea and approve every batch on a weekly cycle without falling behind. The plan shoots on Tuesday and confirms facts on Wednesday at 12:00, so staff may spend their 17 minutes filming ideas that are then blocked. The likely outcome is 1–2 posts in week 1 instead of 5, and the sprint is only 4 weeks long.
refutations.fix: Get the doctor's sheet answered and recorded in one 15-minute sitting during week 0, and record all voice answers in that sitting (batch the audio). Shoot only ideas whose facts are already confirmed. Keep 2 zero-fact reserves ready (ID11 once the sample is confirmed, ID14, which needs no facts).

refutations.target: ID20 patient voice testimonial
refutations.why_fails: Medical-ad rules in RK, like FZ-38 in Russia, generally forbid referring to specific cases of patient treatment or gratitude in medical-service advertising. Getting written consent and a patient voice recording takes effort the clinic can't spare, and the video will very likely never be published. It still sits in the week 1 and week 2 lists and in the reserve queue.
refutations.fix: Drop ID20 from the slate and the reserve order. Use the same fear angle in a FAQ: the doctor reads out anonymised real questions from the WhatsApp export («Боялся, что...» → his answer).

refutations.target: Per-video spoken codes across IG/TikTok/Shorts + phone log
refutations.why_fails: In the CIS, people don't type codes. They write «здравствуйте, сколько имплант» or forward the reel. Five new codes a week across three platforms, plus an admin asking callers «назовите код», will undercount badly. The admin will also stop logging by week 2, and the 'coded floor' will be close to zero for reasons that have nothing to do with the content.
refutations.fix: Use one short code per series (e.g. ДВЕРЬ, ВРАЧ), plus prefilled wa.me links that carry the code automatically. Admin script: «Где вы нас увидели — Instagram, TikTok, 2GIS?» Count forwarded reels in chats as attributed.

refutations.target: Cold organic content as the only lever for a 5-week 1.5× booking push
refutations.why_fails: A ~3k-follower account plus a new TikTok almost never produces 1.5× implant consultations in 4 weeks through organic reach alone. The plan's own range is 2–43 consultations. The fastest source of implant leads is the clinic's own database: patients who had extractions or have failing bridges, already in the records. The plan only mentions WhatsApp Status as a fallback.
refutations.fix: Add a week-1 warm-base action. The admin pulls patients who had extractions or bridge/denture work in the last 24 months and sends an opted-in, doctor-approved personal WhatsApp message with the best «Вопрос врачу» video plus «если хотите обсудить, ответьте ВРАЧ». Track it as a separate arm so it doesn't hide the content results.

refutations.target: ID03 checklist hook «Выбираете клинику для импланта? Смотрите сюда»
refutations.why_fails: The hook is generic, and the two checks (the pouch opened in front of you, the plan shown on a model) are weak reasons to choose a surgeon. Viewers will scroll past it as an ad wearing an advice costume.

output.name: Ask the surgeon first: implant consultations, Almaty (sprint 2026-10-12 → 2026-11-15, revision 1)
output.big_idea: People put off implants because the answers they need come from a surgeon they haven't met yet: does it hurt, what does the price depend on, will they push me into treatment. In this plan the clinic's implant surgeon answers those questions personally. He answers patients already in the clinic's records directly, which gets bookings in October. He answers everyone else on camera with recurring hidden implant steps: the real implant, the plan on the jaw model, and the cases where he advises against one. This can produce 20+ episodes, because each patient question and each implant-specific step is its own episode. It is provable on camera, because only surgeon-confirmed steps and words appear. It points at the measured action, a coded booking or a reply of «ВРАЧ».
output.why_this_wins:
This is not a forecast. Every insight is PROVISIONAL (strength 2): the client is hypothetical and the ledger is empty. The message only invites people to ask; nothing is claimed about the business. It becomes fully true once the surgeon confirms two things in the week-0 session: that the consultation carries no obligation (NEEDS FACT, I02/E17) and that he answers patient questions.

What changed after review, and why:

(1) The base is now the main lever from week 0. Patients already in the clinic's records (MIS) get a personal, doctor-approved WhatsApp message in waves sized to capacity, with reply keyword «ВРАЧ». This is the fastest route to October bookings. Organic content alone has a 10–20× uncertainty range (REALISM in the intake). The base is measured as its own arm so it doesn't hide what content does.

(2) The hero is now «Вопрос хирургу», built on I01, I02 and I03 (E13, E17, E20, E10, E23). It answers fear, the sales-trap worry and price. Sterilisation is no longer the hero. It is one episode (ID02), because it is a worn category convention and not specific to implants.

(3) Price is addressed in week 1. A «от чего зависит цена импланта» episode (I03, no figures) is fast-tracked through step 4. Prices or an «от» range appear only after the owner sends a dated price list.

(4) The CTAs promise something worth writing for: the surgeon's preliminary view of the likely stages, from a photo or X-ray. This is a non-price offer that needs owner and surgeon approval, plus a daily cap.

(5) The surgeon's face is the default ask, because for a surgery decision people want to see who they are going to. A recurring name tag is the fallback. This also tests the shared experiment, face vs hands in frame 1.

(6) Compliance gates: RU+KZ hook and CTA on every video, checked by a native speaker; licence number in the bio and caption; the sanitary-regime lead checks any sterilisation frame. ID20 (patient voice) is removed.

Learning plan: each post is read at 48 h and 7 days against the pooled dental median until the account has 10 posts of its own. Allocation runs on relative views plus shares and saves until 20 coded chats, then on coded chats per 1k views. The base arm is read separately as replies and bookings per message sent.

series.name: Вопрос хирургу
series.role: HERO. Conversion + trust, built on I01, I02 and I03. Metrics: coded chats per 1k views, coded chat → booked consultation rate, saves per 1k. Opening ritual: a question card upper-middle (RU line plus KZ line), and within 0.5 s the implant surgeon answers. Default: his face at a desk, phone on a stack of books at eye level 35–40 cm away (speech-distance rule), or a lav mic if the owner approves. Fallback if he refuses his face: the same desk, his hands on the jaw model, and a fixed name tag «Хирург-имплантолог [имя]», used only with his consent. That gives the series one recognisable person. No tray or cotton-roll B-roll: pictures must match the words (jaw model, demo implant, the surgeon). Every answer is labelled «Мнение врача». The surgeon records all answers in one batched session. The «Нам пишут: …» framing is used only after the export shows ≥2 matching real messages; the surgeon then reads out anonymised real questions, which replaces the patient-voice idea ID20. Episode-7 test: «Можно ли имплант, если зуб удалили давно?»
series.cadence: 2 per week (Thu + Sun) from week 1; ID21 from week 2 once real comments exist. Priority NEXT BATCH episode «от чего зависит цена импланта» (I03) takes a week-1 slot if it passes the rails

series.name: Кабинет имплантолога
series.role: Proof / utility, implant-specific hidden steps the camera can show without patients. Metrics: saves + shares per 1k, profile visits per 1k, then coded chats per 1k. Opening ritual: an implant object already moving in frame 1 (demo implant, jaw model, plan on paper), filmed at 20–30 cm with its own sound, with the tag «Кабинет имплантолога» upper-left. ID03 is published only as a re-cut about how OUR implant consultation goes. Its hook and text move from «выбираете клинику? смотрите сюда» to the visit sequence on the jaw model. The 'check other clinics' lines «Пакет вскрывают при вас?» are removed; the re-cut passes the rails again. ID02 (sterilisation) runs once only, in week 2, after the clinic's sanitary-regime lead has checked every frame. Further episodes go to NEXT BATCH: the CT/plan screen (blurred, no patient data), the surgical kit for one case, the temporary crown model, 'one missing tooth vs three' drawn on paper. Episode-7 test: «Что хирург проверяет, прежде чем сказать „да“ импланту».

series.name: Со стороны
series.role: Reach / exploration wildcard for the adult child who decides for a parent (I07). Metrics: relative views (views_48h ÷ median), shares per 1k, and the share of coded chats written by relatives. Its first frame is a staged phone chat labelled «постановка», which breaks the run of desk and hand openings. It must not mock older people.

offer.proposal: Non-price offer. It is the default CTA for conversion pieces («Вопрос хирургу», «Кабинет имплантолога»), published only after the owner's «да» and the surgeon's agreement: «Пришлите в WhatsApp код {CODE} и фото или снимок — хирург-имплантолог предварительно подскажет, какие этапы обычно нужны в похожей ситуации. Точный план — только после осмотра.» Limits: runs 2026-10-19 → 2026-11-15. At most N replies per working day, where the surgeon sets N in the week-0 session. Above N, the admin offers a consultation slot instead. No diagnosis or price in the reply. We do not write «бесплатно» or «без обязательств» unless the owner confirms it in writing. Test: CTA with this offer vs the soft CTA «расскажем, как проходит консультация» on reach pieces (ID14, ID11). Directional only, because the arms differ. No discounts and no «акции».

channels.channel: Base of existing patients (personal WhatsApp from the admin)
channels.role: PRIMARY lever for the deadline, from week 0. Separate arm with keyword «ВРАЧ». The admin pulls three segments from the MIS for the last 24 months: A, implant consultation/plan given but treatment not started; B, extraction with no replacement recorded; C, bridge or removable denture work. Only patients whose records allow contact by the clinic (NEEDS FACT: consent-to-contact basis). Personal one-to-one messages, not a mass broadcast. Waves: A on 2026-10-16, B in week 1, C in week 2. Wave 1 ≤40 messages; later waves are sized so expected bookings stay ≤80% of free surgeon capacity, using the measured wave-1 rates. One message per person per sprint, no reminders. «НЕТ» → removed for good. Agent-drafted text, approved by the surgeon and the owner: «Здравствуйте, {имя}! Это администратор клиники {название}, вы у нас лечились. Если вы ещё думаете об импланте, наш хирург-имплантолог может ответить на ваши вопросы: что беспокоит, какие этапы обычно нужны. Хотите обсудить — ответьте «ВРАЧ». Не хотите таких сообщений — ответьте «НЕТ», больше не напишем.» Waves 2–3 attach the best published «Вопрос хирургу» episode. Admin time is approved by the owner and budgeted outside the 17 content minutes.

Conversion. Per-video code {CODE}: spoken, on screen ≥2 s (RU+KZ), in the caption and in the pinned comment. Median first reply ≤15 min in working hours; if the week-0 export shows >60 min, that is fixed before more content. Quick reply (owner approves once): «Здравствуйте! Вы по видео {CODE}. Пришлите, пожалуйста, фото или снимок и напишите, какой зуб беспокоит — хирург предварительно подскажет этапы, а мы предложим время консультации.» This is the version after the offer is approved; before approval: «…подскажите, какой зуб беспокоит и когда удобно прийти». Price question (surgeon signs off): «Точную сумму врач называет после осмотра — она зависит от снимка, кости, импланта и коронки. Подобрать время на консультацию?». After the owner's price answer, a dated «от» range can be added. Codeless chats: «Подскажите, откуда о нас узнали?». The handover message after a visit carries a review request, never incentivised.

Main content channel (~3k followers [ASSUMPTION]) and the window where patients check whether a clinic is legitimate. Bio: what the clinic does, district, the medical licence number (NEEDS FACT), and a wa.me link with bio code «БИО». Bio is RU+KZ. Pin 3 posts: the best «Вопрос хирургу», the price-dependency episode, «Как проходит консультация». Highlights: «Как проходит консультация», «Вопросы хирургу», «Отзывы» (public 2GIS quotes, no names, no treatment stories). «Цены» highlight only after a dated price list. Instagram DMs are coded and labelled like WhatsApp.

Judgment extension (the METHOD covers WhatsApp codes only). Codes and «ВРАЧ» are spoken in videos and messages. The admin asks «По какому видео или сообщению вы звоните?» and logs code, date and booked yes/no on a one-page sheet. Missed calls are returned the same day.

Cross-posts only if the owner says «да» (default: Instagram only). TikTok is a cold start: no arm is judged on its first 5–10 posts. Shorts titles are plain, e.g. «Как проходит консультация по имплантам — Алматы», with no numbers or outcomes. Commercial-library or original audio only.
The week's best episode goes to existing contacts, who may forward it to relatives (the I07 route). No availability or urgency claims unless free slots are confirmed that day.

Proof and local intent. The agent fetches rating and reviews in week 0 as the guardrail baseline. Photo refresh with non-patient footage (consultation desk, jaw model). Review request at handover. Paid 2GIS placement can start in week 1 if the owner sets a budget at onboarding and confirms RK medical-ad compliance. It does not depend on our videos proving themselves, so it is not gated by DR2.

The budget question is asked at onboarding, not in week 3. Boosting video posts is still limited to DR2-qualified posts with ≥1 coded chat or a conversion role. Week-1 posts are read at 48 h, so the earliest boost is week 2. Requires the owner's budget and the owner's confirmation of RK medical-ad compliance (we supply RU/KZ text, no legal advice). Cap per coded chat (judgment adaptation: one chat ≠ one sale) = avg implant plan × gross margin × consultation→plan rate × chat→consultation rate × 0.3, all owner numbers. Stop-loss: stop after spending 5× the cap with <3 coded chats, or when cost per coded chat rises 3 days in a row.
