measurement.success_metric: Booked implant consultations, coded (video code or «ВРАЧ», via WhatsApp / Instagram DM / phone), matched to the admin label «Имплант-консультация» and checked for attendance in the schedule. Target: conservative 1.2× / expected 1.5× / stretch 2× the weekly baseline, averaged over weeks 3–4, by 2026-11-15. Baseline = mean weekly implant consultations from the MIS, 2026-09-14 → 10-11. If unavailable, use the week-0 count of uncoded bookings. Absolute numbers and the REALISM verdict are fixed on 2026-11-01. Reported in three lines: base arm («ВРАЧ»), content-coded (video codes, a floor), and total vs baseline (estimate). Lagging metric: plans accepted, to 2026-12-31. REALISM update: [ASSUMPTION] reply rate 5–15% × booking 30–50% → ~2–8 consultations per 100 base messages. The list size is unknown, so the owner's «сотни» is unverified; the estimate is replaced by wave-1 measured rates.
measurement.attribution: Per-video code {CODE}: spoken, on screen ≥2 s (RU+KZ), in the caption and in the pinned comment; prefilled wa.me in the bio. The base arm uses the keyword «ВРАЧ», counted separately and never mixed into content results. Phone: the admin asks for and logs the code (judgment extension). Instagram DMs labelled the same way. Codeless chats are asked «Откуда о нас узнали?». The 30-day attribution window covers multi-week decisions. Paid traffic (2GIS/boost) gets its own codes and is reported as its own line.
leading_indicators: views_48h ÷ median of the last 15 posts on that platform (log ratio per engine); pooled dental median until 10 own posts
3-second hold vs account median (also the face-vs-hands-in-frame-1 shared experiment)
average % watched
shares + saves per 1,000 views
coded chats (WhatsApp + DM + phone) per 1,000 views, and photo/X-ray submissions per 1,000 views (offer pull)
coded chat → booked consultation rate
base arm: replies «ВРАЧ» per 100 messages, bookings per 100 messages, «НЕТ»/complaints per 100 messages
surgeon minutes used per week vs the 15-minute cap
measurement.review_cadence: Every post at 48 h (allocation) and 7 days (final). Each base wave read at 72 h before the next is sized. Weekly campaign read on Monday with a ≤5-line owner report. Targets fixed 2026-11-01. Phase review 2026-11-15. 30-day code window. Mechanism check per idea: driver vs its own metric.

decision_rules: DR0 Publish gate (regulated, judgment): a video goes out only if ALL of these hold: (1) its NEEDS FACT items were confirmed before the Monday card, so unconfirmed ideas are never filmed; (2) the surgeon's weekly batch sign-off and the owner's batch approval are both done in one Wednesday pass; (3) the RU+KZ hook and CTA have passed the native Kazakh check; (4) the caption carries the licence line; (5) any sterilisation or instrument frame has been checked by the clinic's sanitary-regime lead. Failure → a confirmed reserve takes the slot (ID14 → ID11 → ID21).

DR-S Surgeon minutes: cap 15 per week (week 0 = one 15-min session; weeks 1–4 ≤10: the Wednesday batch sign-off plus ≤5 min of new answers every other week). Comment replies come only from the approved template bank, so there is no per-comment approval. If the cap is exceeded or sign-off is late twice → switch the next week to zero-new-recording episodes (ID21, library re-cuts) and cut new questions to 1.
DR-W1 Base waves: wave 1 ≤40 messages. Each later wave = (free consultation slots this week × 0.8 − content bookings) ÷ measured bookings per message. No wave when DR10 is triggered.

DR-W2 Base safety: «НЕТ» → removed for good; one message per person per sprint; no reminders. If «НЕТ» + complaints exceed 10% of a wave (judgment threshold), stop and rewrite the text with the owner. Messages are sent personally in batches of ≤20 per hour to avoid WhatsApp spam blocks.
DR1 Read: every post at 48 h and 7 days against that platform's median of the last 15 posts (pooled dental median until 10 own posts).

DR2 Breakout: ≥3× platform median at 48 h ([ASSUMPTION] Reels median ~1,000 → ≥3,000 views, replaced after the week-0 fetch), or shares+saves per 1k ≥2× median → within 7 days 2 follow-ups (part 2 / same insight in a new format + a reply to the top comment), pin it if conversion-relevant, add it to the next base wave and Status, and mark it boost-eligible. At ≥10× it becomes a series; the owner hears «вирусный» described as a tail event.
DR3 Hook failure: 3-s hold <0.7× account median → re-cut with a different first-frame type and hook, repost ≥7 days later, once.
DR4 Body failure: hold OK, completion <0.7× median → shorten and move the payoff earlier in the next episode.

DR5 Conversion-layer miss: views on plan but coded chats <30% of the 2026-11-01 plan by week 3 → check the spoken and on-screen code, caption, pinned comment, bio link, the offer CTA's visibility, phone logging and reply time before making more content.
DR6 Sales-handling miss: coded chats on plan, bookings low → report where chats die (after price? after photo review?) and draft scripts. Price, any «от» range and the offer are the owner's call.
DR7 Attention-only arm: ≥10 posts, ≥10,000 views, 0 coded chats while other arms convert → 1 post/week.
DR8 Retire: P(arm beats client median) <0.10 after ≥8 posts → exploration floor; data stays in the pool.

DR9 Boost: video boosts only for DR2 posts with ≥1 coded chat or a conversion role, from week 2. 2GIS placement may start week 1 on the owner's budget. Both need owner-confirmed RK compliance. Cap per coded chat = avg plan × margin × consultation→plan × chat→consultation × 0.3 (owner numbers). Stop at 5× the cap with <3 coded chats, or when cost per coded chat rises 3 days in a row. Never with an unapproved offer.

DR10 Capacity: total new implant-consultation bookings (base + content + paid) ≥80% of free surgeon capacity (Q1; default +20% over baseline), or photo-review requests above the surgeon's daily N → pause base waves first, then conversion CTAs, and shift to «Кабинет имплантолога» and reach.
DR11 Honesty kill-switch: a comment credibly disputes a fact or alleges harm → pause that series, move the conversation to private, verify with the surgeon, tell the owner the same day.

DR11b Medical comments: no diagnosis, prognosis or price in public. Use the pre-approved templates only; off-template questions get «это решает врач после осмотра — напишите {CODE}, подскажем, как записаться» and become ID21 candidates.

DR12 Pivot: by week 4–6, no arm with P >0.6 and the primary metric <25% of target → rerun step 3 with fresh chats, base replies and voice notes; diagnose reply time, price position, reviews and surgeon availability; send the owner an honest options report.
DR13 Claims: 'winner' only with P(best) ≥0.9, n ≥10 per contender and an interval; otherwise «лидирует, рано судить».
DR14 Staff: card completion <80% for 2 weeks → fewer locations, shorter takes, more library cuts.
DR15 Owner/surgeon: rejections >30% → read the reasons and update constraints; a fact rejection means fixing the ledger.
DR16 Never delete flops, except for truth, consent, medical-ad, language-law or legal problems.
learning_questions: How many bookings per 100 messages does the base arm («ВРАЧ», by segment A/B/C) produce, compared with content per 1,000 views, and what does each cost in staff minutes and money?
Does a concrete CTA (the surgeon's preliminary stages from a photo or X-ray) raise coded chats per 1k views compared with the soft «расскажем, как проходит консультация»? Directional only.
Shared experiment: does the surgeon's face in frame 1 beat hands with a name tag on 3-s hold and coded chats per 1k? Randomised per «Вопрос хирургу» episode if he consents to his face.
Does the price-dependency episode (I03) turn price-first chats into bookings? Compare where chats die in the week-0 export and in weeks 3–4.
Do adult children write first for a parent (ID14 and base segment C)? Measure the share of coded chats from relatives.

owner_asks.ask: Это ИИ-помощник по роликам. Главный быстрый шаг — ваша база. Разрешаете администратору: 1) выгрузить из МИС число консультаций по имплантам за 4 недели и списки за 24 месяца (неначатый план имплантации / удаление без протезирования / мосты и съёмные протезы), 2) писать лично, волнами по ≤40 человек, только тем, кому по карте можно писать, текстом, который утвердит хирург (без акций и обещаний), 3) тратить на это до 15 минут в день? Да / нет / поправлю. По умолчанию: да, первая волна 16.10.
owner_asks.why: Fixes the boss's fatal point: the warm base is the fastest source of October bookings. The MIS count also gives a 4-week baseline, so outreach doesn't contaminate it.

owner_asks.ask: Пришлите экспорт 15–30 последних чатов WhatsApp про импланты: чат → ⋮ → «Экспорт чата» → «Без медиафайлов». Имена и номера удаляем сразу. По умолчанию (если нет до 16.10): судим по ответам на сообщения базы и комментариям.
owner_asks.why: Needed for real question clusters (the «Нам пишут» framing, which replaces patient voices), the point where chats die, and reply time.

owner_asks.ask: Бюджет на рекламу в октябре–ноябре: 1 — 0 ₸; 2 — да, напишите сумму в месяц и максимум, который готовы платить за одну запись на консультацию; 3 — сначала 2ГИС, потом Instagram. По умолчанию: 1.
owner_asks.why: The boss asked for budget at onboarding. 2GIS can start in week 1; video boosts start once a post qualifies (week 2).

owner_asks.ask: Хирург-имплантолог, одна сессия 15 минут в четверг 15.10: ответы да/нет по листу, запись ответов на вопросы пациентов, утверждение шаблонов ответов. Снимать его: 1 — с лицом (с письменного согласия, это главный рычаг доверия), 2 — только руки и табличка с именем, 3 — только голос. Можно ли купить петличный микрофон (около 1 500 ₸, цена — наше предположение)? По умолчанию: 2, без покупки.
owner_asks.why: Batches all surgeon time into one session (≤15 min/week cap) and asks for his face as the main trust lever, not an optional extra.

owner_asks.ask: Цены: 1 — можно точные (фото прайса с датой); 2 — только вилка «от … до …» по прайсу с датой; 3 — без цифр, только «от чего зависит». И можно ли в CTA: «пришлите фото или снимок — хирург предварительно подскажет этапы» (хирург назовёт, сколько ответов в день)? Да / нет. По умолчанию: 3, CTA без фото.
owner_asks.why: Price is the first question patients ask. A dated «от» range is usable only from a ledger fact. The photo CTA is the non-price offer that gives people a reason to write. Replaces intake Q3.

owner_asks.ask: Соответствие правилам (да/нет, юридическую оценку не даём): 1) номер медицинской лицензии — пришлите, поставим в профиль и подписи; 2) в каждом ролике хук и CTA на русском и казахском — согласны; 3) кто из сотрудников — носитель казахского и вычитает строки (~4 мин/нед); 4) кто отвечает за санрежим и проверит кадры стерилизационной; 5) платная реклама медуслуг допустима — да / уточню у юриста. Рассказы пациентов в этом спринте не делаем. По умолчанию: без лицензии и казахской вычитки ролики не выходят.
owner_asks.why: Language law, licence details and the sanitary check become publishing gates (DR0). The patient-story idea ID20 is dropped.

owner_asks.ask: Утвердите один раз шаблоны ответов в WhatsApp (пришлём 3) и попросите администратора ставить метки «Видео», «ВРАЧ», «Имплант-консультация», а звонящих спрашивать «по какому видео или сообщению?». 1 — да, 2 — поправлю. По умолчанию: 1 с 19.10.
owner_asks.why: Conversion layer and attribution across WhatsApp, DM and phone.

owner_asks.ask: Сколько дополнительных консультаций по имплантам в неделю хирурги реально примут: 1 — до +2, 2 — +3–5, 3 — больше 5 (число)? По умолчанию: +20% к нынешнему. Ответ до 10.10 12:00.
owner_asks.why: Intake Q1. Base waves, photo-review volume and DR10 are all sized from it.

owner_asks.ask: Завести TikTok и YouTube: 1 — да, сами; 2 — дайте доступ нам; 3 — только Instagram. По умолчанию: 3.
owner_asks.why: More free test bed at no staff cost; optional.

owner_asks.ask: Каждую среду (≤5 минут, вместе с визой хирурга): одобрить пакет роликов и волну сообщений базе — «да» / «убрать №…». По умолчанию: без ответа ничего не публикуем и не отправляем.
owner_asks.why: L8 plus the regulated category; this is the weekly budget, separate from the 15 onboarding minutes.

risks: HYPOTHETICAL CLIENT: every business detail is an assumption and the ledger is empty. No number, price, brand, duration, licence or experience claim appears anywhere until a dated fact exists.

Owner onboarding: asks 1–9 total 14 min, plus the intake's capacity question, which is included as ask 8 (15 min). Intake Q2/Q3 are replaced by asks 4 and 5. The weekly approval (5 min) is the separate weekly budget.
Surgeon minutes are a new budget line (cap 15/week). If the week-0 session slips, most of week 1 falls back to ID14, ID11 and library cuts, and the hero starts in week 2.
Admin outreach time (≤15 min/day) is outside the METHOD's 17 staff minutes. It is a sales task the owner explicitly requested and approves; this is a judgment call.
NEEDS FACT: legal basis for contacting patients from the MIS (consent to contact in the patient record / RK personal-data rules) (owner). The base arm does not start without it.
NEEDS FACT: the surgeon agrees to answer base replies and photo/X-ray requests, and his daily cap N (surgeon). Without it the offer and the warm text drop «хирург ответит».
NEEDS FACT: whether the preliminary photo review is free and non-binding (owner). «бесплатно» / «без обязательств» stay off until confirmed.
NEEDS FACT: medical licence number for bio and captions (owner).
NEEDS FACT: named Kazakh-native checker and the sanitary-regime lead (owner).
NEEDS FACT: surgeon consent to face or name on camera; his name for the name tag (surgeon).

NEEDS FACT: anaesthesia/sensation answer in the surgeon's signed-off words (ID04); his real criteria for advising against an implant and the non-binding consultation (ID05); our consultation sequence on the jaw model (ID03 re-cut); demo implant sample without brand (ID11); reprocessing steps and order (ID02).
NEEDS FACT: dated price list or «от» range with what it includes (owner). No figure appears until then; the price episode explains only what the price depends on.
ID03 re-cut changes its hook and text from 'check any clinic' to 'our consultation'. It must pass the rails again at edit time; if rejected, it moves to NEXT BATCH and ID14/ID11 cover the slot.
WhatsApp Business may flag bulk messaging: messages are personal, paced ≤20/hour, and use opt-out wording.
Capacity flood: base + content + paid could exceed surgeon capacity quickly; DR10 pauses base waves first.
REGULATED: no «без боли», «навсегда», «приживается», «за 1 день», no before/after, no patient testimonials (ID20 removed), no AI depiction of results, no diagnosis in comments or photo reviews.
Sterilisation footage is publicly scrutinised: ID02 runs once, only after the sanitary-regime lead's frame check.
Attribution: codes undercount (phone especially); in-sprint surgeries undercount; base, content and paid are reported as separate lines.

NEXT BATCH (priority, mid-cycle step-4 run 2026-10-14): «Вопрос хирургу» episode «От чего зависит цена импланта» (I03; CT, the implant itself, bone grafting if needed, abutment, crown, number of visits; no figures; surgeon-approved; RU+KZ). It takes a week-1 slot if it passes the rails.

NEXT BATCH: «Кабинет имплантолога» episodes: blurred CT/plan screen (no patient data), surgical kit laid out for one case, temporary crown model, 'one tooth vs three' drawn on paper, «что хирург проверяет, прежде чем сказать „да“».
NEXT BATCH: «Нам пишут: „Боялся, что…“» FAQ episodes, with the surgeon reading anonymised real questions once the export shows ≥2 matching messages. This replaces ID20.
NEXT BATCH: a moment idea for I06 (after an extraction; той season planned 10–14 days ahead) and a myth_check for I05 («кости нет», «мост проще»), surgeon-signed.
NEXT BATCH: why_it_costs for I10 only after the owner confirms each cost element and dated prices.

output.persona: Owner and head of a hypothetical dental clinic in Almaty: 6 chairs, 2 implant surgeons, prices above average. I asked for more implant patients. I care about bookings, my staff's time, my licence and my reputation, and much less about Thompson sampling.
output.best_idea: The best part is the personal WhatsApp outreach to our own patients, keyword «ВРАЧ», in three segments. Segment A, people who got an implant plan but never started, is the most valuable. This is the only lever that can realistically fill implant consultations in October, and it is measured separately from the videos. On the content side, ID05 («Когда хирург сам отговаривает от импланта») is the strongest. It speaks directly to the fear patients have of private clinics, which is being upsold.

refutations.target: Base arm: messaging former patients from the MIS records (segments A/B/C)
refutations.why_fails: The message «вы у нас лечились… если вы ещё думаете об импланте» uses health information from medical records for marketing. Medical secrecy and the RK personal-data law apply. The plan hides this under 'NEEDS FACT: consent-to-contact basis' but still schedules wave 1 for 16.10. That is only 6 days away, and nobody has checked whether our patient consent forms cover marketing contact at all. One patient complaint to the regulator costs me more than a whole sprint of bookings. Sending from the admin's WhatsApp at 20 messages an hour can also get our only booking number banned, and then the reply-time guardrail means nothing.
refutations.fix: Before any message goes out, a lawyer checks the consent forms and confirms the legal basis in writing. If the forms don't cover it, send only to patients who agreed to contact. Remove the treatment detail from the text: just «клиника {название}, хирург-имплантолог отвечает на вопросы». Send from a separate WhatsApp Business number, never the main booking line. Keep wave 1 small, around 20 messages.

refutations.target: Offer: «пришлите фото или снимок — хирург предварительно подскажет этапы»
refutations.why_fails: This is a remote opinion on a patient's own X-ray, which is in effect a teleconsultation. It creates liability if the surgeon misses something. It also brings sensitive medical images into WhatsApp. And it gives the patient a reason not to come in, because they already have an answer. With a cap of N replies a day it also creates a new unpaid daily task for a surgeon whose time is my most expensive resource.
refutations.fix: Drop the X-ray review. Offer instead: «опишите ситуацию — администратор подберёт время консультации, хирург ответит на вопросы на приёме». If I still want something concrete, use a fixed, owner-confirmed consultation format, for example «план на модели челюсти + КТ при необходимости». The photo idea comes back only after a legal check and a written protocol.

refutations.target: Price handling: «Точную сумму врач называет после осмотра», and no numbers in content
refutations.why_fails: Our prices are above average, and the first question in every chat is «сколько?». Every clinic in Almaty gives the evasive answer the plan proposes, and patients drop it and go to the clinic that names a figure. Segment A already saw a plan with a price and didn't go ahead. Most likely the reason was price, and the base message says nothing about it. The plan doesn't explain why to pay more at our clinic, so the price-dependency episode only describes the price without justifying it.
refutations.fix: Make the «от … ₸» range the default as soon as I send a dated price list. I can do that this week. Add a quick reply that names what is included («в стоимость входит: …»). For segment A, write a separate message aimed at the price objection: what has changed, whether payment can be split, and who to ask. All of it confirmed by me.

refutations.target: Week-0 surgeon session: everything in one 15-minute session on 15.10
refutations.why_fails: In 15 minutes the surgeon is supposed to fill in the fact sheet, record answers for 4 videos with 3 takes each, approve 8 comment templates and the base messages, and set his daily cap N. That is not realistic. If he is delayed even once, the hero series slips to week 2 and week 1 is left with a staged chat and a fist with a coffee bean. That is not 'more implant patients'.
refutations.fix: Book two sessions of 20–25 minutes on 13.10 and 15.10, and I will block his schedule for them. Send the fact sheet and templates in advance so he only says yes or no. In the session he records answers only, starting with ID05 and ID04.

refutations.target: ID11: hook «Настоящий имплант» vs the label «Демонстрационный образец»
refutations.why_fails: The hook says «real», but the on-screen label says it is a demo sample. That is a contradiction in medical advertising, and someone in the comments will point it out. The coffee bean also implies a size for 'an implant', but implants come in different sizes. The plan itself admits the idea has a weak link to bookings.
refutations.fix: Change the hook to «Так выглядит имплант. Какого он размера?» and keep the demo label. Keep ID11 only as a reserve, not a fixed week-1 slot.

refutations.target: ID03 in the slate still uses «Выбираете клинику для импланта? Смотрите сюда» and «Пакет вскрывают при вас?»
refutations.why_fails: The campaign says ID03 was re-cut around our consultation, but the slate entry, which is what staff will film from, still has the old hook. That old hook is a veiled attack on other clinics. It could be read as unfair comparative advertising and would start a fight with colleagues.
refutations.fix: Update the slate entry (hook, on-screen lines, first frame) to the re-cut version before the Monday card goes to staff.

refutations.target: ID14: staged «мама говорит „мне уже не надо“» and «режет яблоко на кусочки»
refutations.why_fails: A staged scene in medical advertising, plus a hint that an elderly woman can't chew, is borderline. Older viewers may take it as mockery. It also has a weak link to the clinic (brand_link 2).
refutations.fix: Keep the topic, which is adult children deciding for a parent, but drop the apple. Instead, end with the surgeon's answer to «Можно ли имплант в 60+? Решает врач после осмотра». Keep the «постановка» label.

refutations.target: Admin load and the owner's onboarding
refutations.why_fails: The admin gets 15 minutes a day of outreach, plus labels, the phone log and quick replies, while also answering chats within 15 minutes. I get 10 asks with a reply deadline of Saturday 10.10 at 12:00, less than a day away. The lav mic price «около 1 500 ₸» is a guess, and it's embarrassing to put a guessed price in a message to the owner.
refutations.fix: Move the deadline to Monday 12.10. Merge the asks into 3 decisions: base and legal, price and offer, surgeon on camera. Remove the mic price or write 'look it up yourselves'. Name one admin who owns the base, and add up their real total minutes per day.

refutations.target: Plan complexity (DR0–DR16, Thompson sampling, pooled medians)
refutations.why_fails: I don't need 16 rules. I need to know, every Monday, how many people booked an implant consultation and from where. The complexity also hides the honest truth: the base will deliver most of the result, and videos are a long-term investment.
refutations.fix: The weekly report to me is 3 lines: base «ВРАЧ» bookings, video-code bookings, total vs baseline. Keep the decision rules internal.

output.persona: veteran_creator: short-form creator and SMM for local businesses in Kazakhstan/CIS (clinics, salons, HoReCa in Almaty and Astana)
output.best_idea: The best idea is base outreach: personal WhatsApp messages to segment A, patients who got an implant plan but never started it. On a 3k-follower account, Reels at 500–1,500 views won't move bookings within 4 weeks, but a warm list will. On the content side, ID05 («Когда хирург сам отговаривает от импланта») is the one piece that breaks the dental promo pattern. It gets shared because «тут хоть честно». ID14 (mum slicing an apple) has the strongest share mechanic in the slate. Make the surgeon's face the hero, lead with price, and treat ID14 as the main reach play.

refutations.target: Base wave text (warm WhatsApp message to segments A/B/C)
refutations.why_fails: The text is polite and generic, and it gives no reason to reply now. «Если вы ещё думаете об импланте, хирург может ответить на вопросы» reads like a mass broadcast, even when it is sent one by one. Segment A patients already had a consultation and know the surgeon can answer questions. They stalled on price, timing or fear, and nothing in this text addresses any of those. My guess is a 2–5% reply rate, below the plan's 5–15%.
refutations.fix: Personalise from the patient's record: «{имя}, в {месяц/год} доктор {имя} составлял вам план по имплантации. Если вопрос ещё актуален — доктор может пересмотреть план, на этой неделе есть окна {дни}». Name the surgeon. Mention real free slots only when they are confirmed that day. Send it from the clinic number the patient already has saved. For segment B, refer to the extraction date. A specific reference is what gets replies in CIS WhatsApp.

refutations.target: No-face default / hands-only hero «Вопрос хирургу»
refutations.why_fails: Every Almaty clinic posts gloved hands, trays, jaw models and pouches. A hands-only feed from a 3k account looks like stock footage and doesn't help anyone choose a surgeon. For a surgery decision, patients want to know who will operate. The plan says this itself, but then sets the owner ask default to option 2 (hands + name tag). By default, the hero series has no hero.
refutations.fix: Make face consent the default ask, and send a 10-second sample of what the shot looks like. If the surgeon refuses, recruit the second implant surgeon or the chief doctor. If nobody agrees, demote «Вопрос хирургу» to a weekly Stories Q&A and invest in ID05/ID14 and the base arm. Don't run a hero series fronted by hands.

refutations.target: No prices anywhere; price episode only in NEXT BATCH
refutations.why_fails: In Almaty, «сколько стоит имплант?» is the first comment and the first DM almost every time. Content without a figure, plus a CTA like «расскажем, как проходит консультация», brings in a stream of «цена?» messages that die after the reply «врач скажет после осмотра». That is the most common way clinic chats die locally, and the plan's own price script reproduces it. Competitors openly post «от 150 000 ₸».
refutations.fix: Push the owner hard to allow at least a dated «от … ₸ за имплант, коронка отдельно» range. Make the price-dependency episode the week-1 lead, not a reserve. Make the price script end with a concrete next step: two named slot options, plus a request for a photo or X-ray to pre-review.

refutations.target: RU+KZ hook and CTA burned into every video + weekly native check as a publish gate (DR0)
refutations.why_fails: Two hook lines in two languages in the top-middle zone halve readability in the first second, and the frame gets cluttered on a small phone. Making the Kazakh check a hard gate means one sick or absent staff member blocks the entire week's posts. With 17 staff minutes, adding 4 minutes of KZ reading every week is a real cost.
refutations.fix: Make the frame-1 hook one language, and test RU-first vs KZ-first episodes as an experiment. Put the bilingual text in the caption and on the CTA end card. Pre-translate a fixed bank of CTA and label lines once in week 0, so the weekly check only covers new hooks. If the checker is unavailable, publish with the approved bank instead of blocking. The owner confirms what the law actually requires for organic posts.

refutations.target: Week-0 surgeon session: 15 minutes for fact sheet + 4 voice answers + template bank + cap N
refutations.why_fails: Recording four usable spoken answers with three takes each, in a «тихий угол» of a working clinic, takes 15 minutes on its own. Add retakes after a drill noise or the admin calling out, plus reviewing 8 reply templates. A surgeon between patients won't do it in one sitting. The result will be ID04 and ID05 audio with background noise and «эээ», or the session slips, and the plan admits that a slip hollows out week 1.
refutations.fix: Split the session. Send the fact sheet and the template bank as WhatsApp text for yes/no replies (async, 0 recording minutes). Use the live 15 minutes only for recording, two episodes per session, after hours, phone on books at 30 cm, with a 1-minute audio test first. Buy a lav mic (realistically 3–6k ₸, not 1,500) without waiting for a decision. It is the cheapest quality fix in the whole plan.

refutations.target: ID02 sterilisation backstage and the ID03 re-cut («как проходит наша консультация»)
refutations.why_fails: Sterilisation pouches are the most overused dental Reel in the CIS. Nobody shares one from a 3k account, and showing a used instrument risks «фу» comments. The ID03 re-cut, «как проходит наша консультация», is a plain ad. With the 'check any clinic' lines removed, it has no share or save reason left. Both cost staff minutes and sign-off gates that ID05, ID14 and the price episode need more.
refutations.fix: Cut ID02 from this sprint, or keep it only as a 7-second Story. Replace the ID03 re-cut with «что хирург проверяет, прежде чем сказать „да“» (already in NEXT BATCH). That has a real payoff and practical value.

refutations.target: Attribution via per-video codes spoken + on screen + pinned comment
refutations.why_fails: Local patients don't type codes. They write «здравствуйте, сколько стоит имплант» or just call. With 20 videos you get 20 codes, and the admin won't keep them straight. The coded floor will be near zero, so DR5 and DR7 will fire on noise and kill working arms.
refutations.fix: Put one prefilled wa.me link per series in the bio and Stories, with the text prefilled (e.g. «Вопрос хирургу») so nobody has to type it. The admin asks one question: «видели нас в Instagram или получили сообщение?». Judge content on total uncoded inquiries vs baseline plus profile→WhatsApp clicks, not on video codes.

refutations.target: ID04 «Это больно?» without any claim
refutations.why_fails: Once «без боли», «не почувствуете» and any protocol detail are banned, the answer becomes «ощущения индивидуальны, врач объяснит на приёме». That is a hook with no payoff, and viewers swipe and feel baited. The plan blocks the idea unless the protocol is confirmed, but week 1 still schedules it for Sunday.
refutations.fix: Rewrite the payoff around concrete, allowed process facts: what the anaesthesia is (an injection, like a filling), how long the appointment roughly takes, what the next day usually looks like, and what to do if it hurts. Each fact is in the surgeon's own words and signed off. Schedule ID04 only after the wording is approved.

refutations.target: Missing cheap channels: Instagram Stories Q&A and TikTok defaulted off
refutations.why_fails: For a 3k local account, daily Stories (a question sticker, «спросите хирурга», a poll on the fear) bring more DMs than Reels and cost about 1 staff minute. They don't appear in the plan. TikTok is huge in Kazakhstan for the 25–45 adult children that ID14 targets, and cross-posting costs nothing. The default «только Instagram» throws that reach away.
refutations.fix: Add 3 Stories a week: a question sticker on Monday, the surgeon's answer on Wednesday, and a link sticker to WhatsApp on Friday. Make TikTok cross-posting the default unless the owner says no, with no judgement on the account's first 10 posts.

refutations.target: Plan complexity (DR0–DR16, Thompson allocation, 10 owner asks)
refutations.why_fails: A 6-chair clinic owner gets about 14 minutes of numbered multiple-choice questions, a legal checklist and the base export all at once. Some answers won't come back by 10.10, so the defaults apply, and several defaults are 'block publishing'. The machinery is heavier than 20 posts justify.
refutations.fix: Cut onboarding to 4 must-answer asks: base outreach yes/no, surgeon face, price range, licence number. Mark everything else as asked in week 1. The owner sees one report line per week: inquiries vs baseline.
